title: Italian MEP on hunger strike over humanitarian crisis in Russian-occupied Oleshky
lede: An Italian MEP has gone on hunger strike over the besieged Ukrainian town's lack of access to food, medicine, clean water and basic care. The only route to escape is tapped with mines and rife with attack drones.

title: International Criminal Court wins EU’s top human rights prize in defiance of Trump’s sanctions
lede: The ICC has received the EU’s Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought. The court's president judge thanked lawmakers for the recognition and said "there is no peace without justice and no security without law".
